cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of resolution-aspect-decision (resolution-and-aspect-ratio-pinner) with contract handoff to composition-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Apply resolution-aspect-decision for a retina web hero banner (16:9 aspect ratio, 2880x1620 master render downscaled to 1920x1080 and 960x540 responsive breakpoints).

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (target_delivery_surfaces) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio, safe_frame_and_overscan_margins, camera_sensor_fit_alignment_notes for role resolution-and-aspect-ratio-pinner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to composition-quality-checker (Composition framing validation against pinned aspect)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio, safe_frame_and_overscan_margins, camera_sensor_fit_alignment_notes conforming to skills/resolution-aspect-decision/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to composition-quality-checker in skills/resolution-aspect-decision/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio and hand off to composition-quality-checker (Composition framing validation against pinned aspect).
simulatedOutput.summary: Pinned 16:9 aspect ratio, 2880x1620 master render resolution (100% scale), downscale derivative table (1920x1080, 960x540), and safe-area crop rules. Delivered 16:9, 2880x1620, downscale derivative and routed to composition-quality-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in resolution-aspect-decision
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during resolution-aspect-decision with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for resolution-aspect-decision and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for resolution-aspect-decision.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (target_delivery_surfaces) for resolution-aspect-decision halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Pin the exact render pixel resolution and aspect ratio without telling me whether the output is for desktop web hero, vertical mobile stories, or print poster.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'target_delivery_surfaces' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement required by resolution-aspect-decision (target_delivery_surfaces)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'target_delivery_surfaces' (target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement (target_delivery_surfaces) before resolution-aspect-decision locks pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted resolution-aspect-decision due to missing required input 'target_delivery_surfaces' (target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent target placement channel (web vs mobile vs print) and aspect ratio requirement when 'target_delivery_surfaces' is omitted.
